sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 2015
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 2016
ACT V OF 2016
SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE
AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
An
Act to amend the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and
Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd March, 2016]
NO.PAS/Legis-B-32/2015, dated 22.3.2016.---The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education
(Amendment) Bill, 2015 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 18th January, 2016 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 8th March, 2016 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
AND WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary
Education (Amendment) Act, 2015.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Act No. XXIII of 2013.---In the Sindh
Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972, hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 3, in subsection (1)
(i) in clause (d), the
word and shall be deleted;
(ii) in clause (e), for the full stop occurring at
the end, the semi colon and the word and shall be substituted and thereafter
the following shall be substituted:-
"(f)
at Shaheed Benazirabad, a Board called the Board of Intermediate and
Secondary Education, Shaheed Benazirabad. .
